title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Liverpool Barcola Transfer Agreement: Liverpool reached a headline £100m+ verbal agreement to sign PSG winger Bradley Barcola.

items.title: @ClementDelangue: Hugging Face Unveils $399 Open-Source Microduck Robot
items.body: Hugging Face announced Microduck, a compact $399 open-source robotics platform designed for developers to train and test interactive AI behaviors and physical actions.

items.title: @OpenAI: Joint AI Cybersecurity Defense Coalition
items.body: OpenAI announced a collaborative initiative alongside Anthropic, AWS, Google, and Microsoft to leverage frontier AI models for rapid vulnerability detection and global infrastructure defense.

items.title: @Polymarket: OpenAI 1,200 AI Agent Swarm Experiment Revealed
items.body: Details surfaced regarding OpenAI's autonomous multi-agent testing, revealing a swarm of ~1,200 agents demonstrating emergent cooperative and sacrificial strategy behaviors.

items.title: @jarredsumner: Claude Code Footprint Reduced by 45%
items.body: Bun creator Jarred Sumner highlighted performance optimizations in the upcoming Claude Code release, cutting the executable size by 45% for faster CLI startup times.

items.title: @esandurrani: Honen Converts Company Knowledge into AI Courses
items.body: Esan introduced Honen, an AI platform developed with NVIDIA support that automatically transforms proprietary codebase and documentation context into self-improving interactive courses.

items.title: @t20000622yy: Developer Tool Hits #1 Global Trending on GitHub
items.body: An open-source developer tool surged to the top spot on GitHub Trending worldwide, gaining massive traction across international developer communities.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: JPMorgan Warns of Global Food Supply Chain Risks
items.body: JPMorgan published a macro alert warning of potential large-scale agricultural and food supply disruption risks over the coming year due to climate and trade headwinds.

items.title: @WhiteHouse: Official Geographic Renaming Proclamation
items.body: The White House issued an executive proclamation officially renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America, sparking wide political and diplomatic discussion.

items.title: @zzwinwinwin: Auto Tech Supplier Graduate Dispute Triggers EU Complaint
items.body: A viral corporate dispute at $30B auto component supplier Xingyu saw 400 engineering graduate hires reassigned to factory floor assembly lines, prompting escalation to labor bodies.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Liverpool Reach Verbal Agreement for Bradley Barcola
items.body: Fabrizio Romano reported a marquee football transfer as Liverpool reached a verbal agreement to sign PSG winger Bradley Barcola for £100m upfront plus add-ons up to €140m.

items.title: @cutelipssx: Costco Healthcare Support for Terminally Ill Staff
